+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+class RefreshSessionError(Exception):
+    pass
+
+
+class Auth0SessionRefresher:
+    def __init__(self, domain: Optional[str] = None, client_id: Optional[str] = None, client_secret: Optional[str] = None):
+        self.domain = domain or os.environ.get("AUTH0_DOMAIN")
+        self.client_id = client_id or os.environ.get("AUTH0_CLIENT_ID")
+        self.client_secret = client_secret or os.environ.get("AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET")
+        if not self.domain or not self.client_id or not self.client_secret:
+            raise RefreshSessionError("AUTH0_DOMAIN, AUTH0_CLIENT_ID, and AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET are required")
+
+    def refresh(self, refresh_token: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+        url = f"https://{self.domain}/oauth/token"
+        payload = {
+            "grant_type": "refresh_token",
+            "client_id": self.client_id,
+            "client_secret": self.client_secret,
+            "refresh_token": refresh_token,
+        }
+        response = requests.post(url, json=payload, timeout=30)
+        if response.status_code >= 400:
+            try:
+                error_detail = response.json()
+            except ValueError:
+                error_detail = {"error": response.text}
+            raise RefreshSessionError(f"Auth0 token refresh failed: {error_detail}")
+        data = response.json()
+        return {
+            "access_token": data.get("access_token"),
+            "id_token": data.get("id_token"),
+            "refresh_token": data.get("refresh_token", refresh_token),
+            "expires_in": data.get("expires_in"),
+            "token_type": data.get("token_type"),
+            "scope": data.get("scope"),
+        }
+
+
+def refresh_session(refresh_token: str, domain: Optional[str] = None, client_id: Optional[str] = None, client_secret: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    return Auth0SessionRefresher(domain=domain, client_id=client_id, client_secret=client_secret).refresh(refresh_token)

+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+AUTH0_DOMAIN = os.getenv("AUTH0_DOMAIN", "")
+AUTH0_CLIENT_ID = os.getenv("AUTH0_CLIENT_ID", "")
+AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET = os.getenv("AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET", "")
+AUTH0_CONNECTION = os.getenv("AUTH0_CONNECTION", "Username-Password-Authentication")
+
+
+class RegistrationError(Exception):
+    pass
+
+
+def _management_token() -> str:
+    if not AUTH0_DOMAIN:
+        raise RegistrationError("AUTH0_DOMAIN is required")
+    if not AUTH0_CLIENT_ID:
+        raise RegistrationError("AUTH0_CLIENT_ID is required")
+    if not AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET:
+        raise RegistrationError("AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET is required")
+
+    url = f"https://{AUTH0_DOMAIN}/oauth/token"
+    payload = {
+        "grant_type": "client_credentials",
+        "client_id": AUTH0_CLIENT_ID,
+        "client_secret": AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET,
+        "audience": f"https://{AUTH0_DOMAIN}/api/v2/",
+    }
+    response = requests.post(url, json=payload, timeout=30)
+    if response.status_code >= 400:
+        raise RegistrationError(f"Auth0 token request failed: {response.text}")
+    data = response.json()
+    token = data.get("access_token")
+    if not token:
+        raise RegistrationError("Auth0 token response missing access_token")
+    return token
+
+
+def register_user(email: str, password: str, name: Optional[str] = None, metadata: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    token = _management_token()
+    url = f"https://{AUTH0_DOMAIN}/api/v2/users"
+    payload: Dict[str, Any] = {
+        "email": email,
+        "password": password,
+        "connection": AUTH0_CONNECTION,
+    }
+    if name:
+        payload["name"] = name
+    if metadata:
+        payload["user_metadata"] = metadata
+
+    headers = {
+        "Authorization": f"Bearer {token}",
+        "Content-Type": "application/json",
+    }
+    response = requests.post(url, json=payload, headers=headers, timeout=30)
+    if response.status_code >= 400:
+        raise RegistrationError(f"Auth0 user creation failed: {response.text}")
+    return response.json()
+
*** End Patch
